shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && git log --oneline | head && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore __agent_eval__/run.mjs; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Table/Table.d.ts; ls Table/hoc; cat Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts; cat Pagination/Pagination.d.ts Pagination/types.d.ts; cat Table/index.d.ts

rm -rf dist && (which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; node -e "require.resolve('playwright')" 2>&1 | head -1; npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1 | head -1)
